author: ohtadmin
title: Local police to be assessed by state
text:
A team of assessors from the Rhode Island Police Accreditation Commission will visit the police station next week to examine every aspect of the department’s policies, procedures, management, operations and support services.
Verification by the assessment team ensures the department meets the commission’s standards. It is part of the voluntary process seeking recognition of professional excellence in law enforcement.
As part of the on-site assessment, the community is invited to provide comments to the assessors by calling 401-423-1212 ext. 4331 between 1-2 p.m. Tuesday, Oct. 14.
Comments are limited to 10 minutes and must address the department’s ability to comply with the commission’s standards, which are available for review at the police station. Questions concerning compliance should be directed to Lt. Karen Catlow at 401-423-1212 ext. 4303.
Members of the community wishing to offer written comments should contact Christine Crocker at 401-440-4352 or crocker.ripac@cox.net.
Accreditation is for three years. During this time, accredited departments must submit annual reports attesting to their continued compliance of the standards.
